# Resource: stripe_invoiceitem

A line to add to a customer's next invoice, or to a draft invoice. `terraform destroy` deletes the invoice item; one that Stripe deleted along with its draft invoice is already gone, and its destroy succeeds. Stripe refuses to delete or change one whose invoice is finalized or void; remove it from the state with `terraform state rm` then.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "stripe_customer" "acme" {
  email = "billing@acme.example"
}

# Added to the customer's next invoice.
resource "stripe_invoiceitem" "setup_fee" {
  customer    = stripe_customer.acme.id
  amount      = 5000
  currency    = "usd"
  description = "One-time setup fee"
}
```

## Argument Reference

The following arguments are optional:

* `amount` - (Optional) The integer amount in cents (or local equivalent) of the charge to be applied to the upcoming invoice. Passing in a negative `amount` will reduce the `amount_due` on the invoice.
* `currency` - (Optional) Three-letter [ISO currency code](https://www.iso.org/iso-4217-currency-codes.html), in lowercase. Must be a [supported currency](https://stripe.com/docs/currencies). Changing it replaces the resource.
* `customer` - (Optional) The ID of the customer to bill for this invoice item. Changing it replaces the resource.
* `customer_account` - (Optional) The ID of the account representing the customer to bill for this invoice item. Changing it replaces the resource.
* `description` - (Optional) An arbitrary string which you can attach to the invoice item. The description is displayed in the invoice for easy tracking.
* `discountable` - (Optional) Controls whether discounts apply to this invoice item. Defaults to false for prorations or negative invoice items, and true for all other invoice items.
* `invoice` - (Optional) The ID of an existing invoice to add this invoice item to. For subscription invoices, when left blank, the invoice item will be added to the next upcoming scheduled invoice. For standalone invoices, the invoice item won't be automatically added unless you pass `pending_invoice_item_behavior: 'include'` when creating the invoice. This is useful when adding invoice items in response to an invoice.created webhook. You can only add invoice items to draft invoices and there is a maximum of 250 items per invoice. Changing it replaces the resource.
* `metadata` - (Optional) Set of [key-value pairs](https://docs.stripe.com/api/metadata) that you can attach to an object. This can be useful for storing additional information about the object in a structured format. Individual keys can be unset by posting an empty value to them. All keys can be unset by posting an empty value to `metadata`.
* `period` - (Optional) The period associated with this invoice item. When set to different values, the period will be rendered on the invoice. If you have [Stripe Revenue Recognition](https://docs.stripe.com/revenue-recognition) enabled, the period will be used to recognize and defer revenue. See the [Revenue Recognition documentation](https://docs.stripe.com/revenue-recognition/methodology/subscriptions-and-invoicing) for details. See [`period`](#period) below.
* `price_data` - (Optional) Data used to generate a new [Price](https://docs.stripe.com/api/prices) object inline. See [`price_data`](#price_data) below.
* `pricing` - (Optional) The pricing information for the invoice item. See [`pricing`](#pricing) below.
* `quantity` - (Optional) Non-negative integer. The quantity of units for the invoice item. Use `quantity_decimal` instead to provide decimal precision. This field will be deprecated in favor of `quantity_decimal` in a future version.
* `quantity_decimal` - (Optional) Non-negative decimal with at most 12 decimal places. The quantity of units for the invoice item.
* `subscription` - (Optional) The ID of a subscription to add this invoice item to. When left blank, the invoice item is added to the next upcoming scheduled invoice. When set, scheduled invoices for subscriptions other than the specified subscription will ignore the invoice item. Use this when you want to express that an invoice item has been accrued within the context of a particular subscription. Changing it replaces the resource.
* `tax_behavior` - (Optional) Only required if a [default tax behavior](https://docs.stripe.com/tax/products-prices-tax-categories-tax-behavior#setting-a-default-tax-behavior-(recommended)) was not provided in the Stripe Tax settings. Specifies whether the price is considered inclusive of taxes or exclusive of taxes. One of `inclusive`, `exclusive`, or `unspecified`. Once specified as either `inclusive` or `exclusive`, it cannot be changed. Possible values: `exclusive`, `inclusive`, `unspecified`.
* `tax_code` - (Optional) A [tax code](https://docs.stripe.com/tax/tax-categories) ID.
* `tax_rates` - (Optional) The tax rates which apply to the invoice item. When set, the `default_tax_rates` on the invoice do not apply to this invoice item.
* `unit_amount_decimal` - (Optional) The decimal unit amount in cents (or local equivalent) of the charge to be applied to the upcoming invoice. This `unit_amount_decimal` will be multiplied by the quantity to get the full amount. Passing in a negative `unit_amount_decimal` will reduce the `amount_due` on the invoice. Accepts at most 12 decimal places.

<a id="period"></a>
### `period`

The `period` attribute supports:

* `end` - (Required) The end of the period, which must be greater than or equal to the start. This value is inclusive.
* `start` - (Required) The start of the period. This value is inclusive.

<a id="price_data"></a>
### `price_data`

The `price_data` attribute supports:

* `currency` - (Required)
* `product` - (Required)
* `tax_behavior` - (Optional) Possible values: `exclusive`, `inclusive`, `unspecified`.
* `unit_amount` - (Optional)
* `unit_amount_decimal` - (Optional)

<a id="pricing"></a>
### `pricing`

The `pricing` attribute supports:

* `price` - (Optional)
* `price_details` - (Read-Only) See [`pricing.price_details`](#pricing.price_details) below.
* `type` - (Read-Only) The type of the pricing details. Possible values: `price_details`.
* `unit_amount_decimal` - (Read-Only) The unit amount (in the `currency` specified) of the item which contains a decimal value with at most 12 decimal places.

<a id="pricing.price_details"></a>
### `pricing.price_details`

The `pricing.price_details` attribute supports:

* `price` - The ID of the price this item is associated with.
* `product` - The ID of the product this item is associated with.

## Attribute Reference

This resource exports the following attributes in addition to the arguments above:

* `id` - Unique identifier for the object.
* `date` - Time at which the object was created. Measured in seconds since the Unix epoch.
* `frozen_fields` - Array of field names that can't be modified. Attempting to update a frozen field returns an error.
* `invoicing_rules` - The rules that control when this invoice item is eligible for invoicing. All rules must be satisfied for the item to be invoiced. See [`invoicing_rules`](#invoicing_rules) below.
* `livemode` - If the object exists in live mode, the value is `true`. If the object exists in test mode, the value is `false`.
* `net_amount` - The amount after discounts, but before credits and taxes. This field is `null` for `discountable=true` items.
* `parent` - The parent that generated this invoice item. See [`parent`](#parent) below.
* `proration` - Whether the invoice item was created automatically as a proration adjustment when the customer switched plans.
* `proration_details` - See [`proration_details`](#proration_details) below.
* `test_clock` - ID of the test clock this invoice item belongs to.

<a id="invoicing_rules"></a>
### `invoicing_rules`

The `invoicing_rules` attribute is a list. Each element supports:

* `type` - The type of invoicing rule. Possible values: `defer_until_credited_items_resolved`.

<a id="parent"></a>
### `parent`

The `parent` attribute supports:

* `subscription_details` - Details about the subscription that generated this invoice item See [`parent.subscription_details`](#parent.subscription_details) below.
* `type` - The type of parent that generated this invoice item Possible values: `subscription_details`.

<a id="parent.subscription_details"></a>
### `parent.subscription_details`

The `parent.subscription_details` attribute supports:

* `subscription` - The subscription that generated this invoice item
* `subscription_item` - The subscription item that generated this invoice item

<a id="proration_details"></a>
### `proration_details`

The `proration_details` attribute supports:

* `credited_items` - For a credit proration, links to the debit invoice line items or invoice item that the credit applies to. See [`proration_details.credited_items`](#proration_details.credited_items) below.
* `discount_amounts` - Discount amounts applied when the proration was created. This field is only populated for prorations created from subscriptions with `billing_mode=flexible`. See [`proration_details.discount_amounts`](#proration_details.discount_amounts) below.

<a id="proration_details.credited_items"></a>
### `proration_details.credited_items`

The `proration_details.credited_items` attribute supports:

* `invoice_item` - When `type` is `invoice_item`, the invoice item id for the debited invoice item corresponding to this credit proration.
* `invoice_line_item_details` - See [`proration_details.credited_items.invoice_line_item_details`](#proration_details.credited_items.invoice_line_item_details) below.
* `type` - Whether the credit references a pending invoice item or one or more invoice line items on an invoice. Possible values: `invoice_item`, `invoice_line_items`.

<a id="proration_details.credited_items.invoice_line_item_details"></a>
### `proration_details.credited_items.invoice_line_item_details`

The `proration_details.credited_items.invoice_line_item_details` attribute supports:

* `invoice` - The invoice id for the debited line item(s).
* `invoice_line_items` - IDs of the debited invoice line item(s) on the invoice that correspond to the credit proration.

<a id="proration_details.discount_amounts"></a>
### `proration_details.discount_amounts`

The `proration_details.discount_amounts` attribute is a list. Each element supports:

* `amount` - The amount, in cents (or local equivalent), of the discount.
* `discount` - The discount that was applied to get this discount amount.

## Timeouts

[Configuration options](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/resources/syntax#operation-timeouts) are set with the `timeouts` attribute, for example `timeouts = { create = "5m" }`:

* `create` - (Default `20m`)
* `delete` - (Default `20m`)
* `update` - (Default `20m`)

## Import

In Terraform v1.5.0 and later, and in OpenTofu, use an [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) to import an invoiceitem using its ID. For example:

```terraform
import {
  to = stripe_invoiceitem.setup_fee
  id = "ii_123"
}
```

In Terraform v1.12.0 and later, and in OpenTofu v1.12.0 and later, the `import` block can use the `identity` attribute instead. For example:

```terraform
import {
  to = stripe_invoiceitem.setup_fee
  identity = {
    id = "ii_123"
  }
}
```

### Identity Schema

#### Required

* `id` (String) The Stripe ID of the invoiceitem.

Using `terraform import`, import an invoiceitem using its ID. For example:

```console
% terraform import stripe_invoiceitem.setup_fee ii_123
```

~> Stripe does not return `price_data`, `pricing.price`, `tax_behavior`, `tax_code`, `unit_amount_decimal` or `subscription`, so an imported invoiceitem has them null: a configuration that sets `price_data`, `pricing.price`, `tax_behavior`, `tax_code` or `unit_amount_decimal` plans an update after the import, and one that sets `subscription` plans a replacement.
